crossRefs.note: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

parallels.note: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.
Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

people.name: Bukki
people.line: High priest, son of Abishua and father of Uzzi

people.name: Uzzi
people.line: High priest in the line of Eleazar
